name: Ptolemeus
description: Called Macron; choosing to do justice to the Jews for past wrongs, he endeavoured to keep peace with them; accused before Eupator by the king's friends and called traitor for having left Cyprus, which Philometor had committed to him, and departed to Antiochus Epiphanes, he poisoned himself for shame when he saw he had no honourable place
